figures.caption: Fig. 3: Per-subgroup AUC by gender and race for the three discriminating models (age bands and exact values in Table S1). Qwen3-VL-8B is uniformly perfect; Claude Opus 4.8 varies by ≤1.5 AUC points across gender; Gemma-3-12B shows the largest disparities. The Black group is small (ni = 272), so Gemma’s high value there should be read with caution.
